title: Revise the commons-governance principles in 3.4.2
requirements:
- Keep the subsidiarity bullet to 'authority at the lowest effective level' and move mandate/execution matching to the next principle
- Distinguish legitimate high demand from avoidable or uncompensated use
- Cite the design-principles literature (Ostrom) as the empirical basis for the governance principles
- Give criteria for deciding which decisions must remain national
- Favour designing for scale and graceful degradation before rationing
- Consider whether the missing principles (boundaries, monitoring, graduated sanctions) should be added
- Recognise existing subnational arrangements that already meet the standard rather than displacing them
- Require consistent, auditable usage measurement before usage data drives restrictions or charges
